historical.title: Local root number under quadratic twist
historical.objects_and_maps: Good odd primes newly ramified in squarefree twist parameter; old places held in fixed squareclasses.
historical.hypotheses_and_discharge: Apply new-prime factor only at good odd p; old dyadic places handled by local isomorphism, including parameters with discriminant4h.
historical.conventions: Local factor (-1/p); distinguish signed squarefree parameter and its fundamental discriminant.
historical.translation_justification: Product of new odd factors determined by real sign and dyadic class. No odd-discriminant-only global formula applied to4h.

verbatim_application_proposal.hypothesis_status: Source hypotheses, objects, maps and conventions freshly validated at the bound manuscript; stated downstream dependencies retained.
